title: 'Home Z' on its own only with the nozzle over the build plate (X and Y homed)
note: The Q2 homes Z with the nozzle itself as the probe. QIDI's homing_override covers only X and Y, so 'G28 Z' on its own (Fluidd's 'Home Z' button, QIDI Studio's device page, the console) homed Z wherever the head stood - also over the purge bin or the plate edge, where the nozzle has nothing to touch. homing_override now also takes 'G28 Z' alone (axes: xyz) and refuses it unless X and Y are homed and the nozzle is over the build plate (X 0 to under 271, Y 5 to under 271: at least 5 mm inside the PEI edges measured on a Q2); otherwise it runs the plain Z homing exactly as before. The head is never moved for it. Home All (G28) and every QIDI macro are unchanged: Home All still centres the head before homing Z, and the screen's plate calibration (M4030) homes Z at X240 Y32, inside the allowed area. This is the behaviour of Marlin 1.0's Z_SAFE_HOMING for 'G28 Z' ('Home X/Y before Z', 'Z probe out. bed'). A wrapper macro named G28 cannot be used: QIDI's Home All calls 'G28 Z' inside homing_override, and Klipper refuses a macro that calls itself.
